description: Office of the Governor - Uva Province - Amendment the Subjects to the 2 Ministries of Uva Province
reasoning: This gazette exclusively details structural/administrative changes to the subjects and responsibilities of ministries within the Uva Provincial Council. This fits the definition of an Organisational Gazette (Type 1), which covers government restructuring, renaming, merging, or the assignment of functions to ministries/departments.
